column1: # context: a Feed switch under Muted words, from the Keep Home feed patch. When it's on, the Home feed doesn't load new pins by itself when the person comes back to the app or to the Home tab, so the pins they were looking at stay put. Pulling down on Home still loads new ones. The title is also the patch's name in the build report and in the settings import preview
Keep Home feed
column2: Mantener el feed de inicio

column1: Home keeps the pins you were looking at when you come back to Pinterest or to the Home tab. Pull down on Home to load new pins.
column2: El feed de inicio conserva los pines que estabas viendo cuando vuelves a Pinterest o a la pestaña Inicio. Desliza hacia abajo en Inicio para cargar pines nuevos.

column1: # context: an Interface switch under Original images, from the Show posted date patch. When it's on, the day a pin was posted shows in small text under the pin's title when the pin is opened. The title is also the patch's name in the build report and in the settings import preview. In Posted %1$s, %1$s is the date written the phone's way, such as Oct 12, 2026

Hide Assistant

column2: Quita el Asistente de IA de Pinterest de la búsqueda, los tableros y los pines. La búsqueda funciona como siempre. El cambio se ve la próxima vez que se actualice la pantalla.

column1: # context: a Feed switch from the Filter feed patch. It takes pins the person has already saved to a board out of their home feed only; boards and search still show them. The title is also the name of that part of the patch in the build report.
Hide pins you've already saved

column1: Takes pins you've saved out of your home feed. Your boards and search still show them.
column2: Quita de tu feed de inicio los pines que guardaste. Tus tableros y la búsqueda los siguen mostrando.
